podcast.title: Leeds Festival Injuries (2003)
podcast.body: System of a Down experienced a significant front-of-stage crush incident during their performance at the Leeds Festival in 2003, which resulted in injuries to 23 fans. "System of a Down, who saw 23 fans injured during the 2003 Leeds Festival."

podcast.title: Shared Combatant Spirit
podcast.body: System of a Down, along with Cypress Hill, embraced a combatant spirit against the system, choosing to focus on external societal issues rather than solely personal sentiments, reflecting a thematic continuity inherited from Rage Against the Machine's influence. The band's "sáalbondes" was explicitly linked to RATM's "you are not a slave" message. "Cómo sistema fadda aún, o cómo los Cypress Hill también retomaban ese espíritu combatiente en contra del sistema inotanto, en contra del sentimiento personal...salió después el famoso style de sáalbondes de Sistema Fadam."

podcast.title: Tackles War and Armenian Genocide
podcast.body: System of a Down is recognized for addressing significant and often heavy themes in their music, specifically tackling subjects like war and the Armenian genocide. "System of a down tackles war in the Armenian genocide."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Zero DB Initiative Signatory
podcast.body: System of a Down is one of the artists who signed the Zero DB initiative, established in 2008 by the charity Reprieve. This initiative aims to condemn the use of music as torture and to encourage governments to uphold the Convention Against Torture and other treaties on prisoner treatment. "The Sinees include Tom Morello, average against the machine, members of REM, rise against Pearl Jam, Trent Reznor, Limp Biscuit, system of a down, disturbed the estate of Prince, the Chili Peppers, Eminem, Marilyn Manson, Neil Diamond, Dr. Dre, and a host of others."

xref.title: Chester Bennington Tribute Concert (2017)
xref.body: On October 27, 2017, a three-hour tribute concert for Chester Bennington was held at the Hollywood Bowl. The event featured friends from Blink 182, System of a Down, Korn, and Avenged Sevenfold, and was streamed live, reaching millions of viewers as Linkin Park paid tribute to their fallen bandmate. "On October 27th, 2017, there was a three hour tribute to Chester featuring his friends from Blink 182, system of a downed corn, a bench, seven fold and more."

xref.title: Owner of Torpedo Comics
xref.body: John Dolmayan, the drummer for System of a Down, is also the proprietor of Torpedo Comics, recognized as one of America's premier comic book stores. Located in Las Vegas, the store operates out of a 3,500 square foot space and has been in business since 2003, specializing in rare comic books. "He's also the owner of one of the best comic book stores in America. It's called Turpedo Comics."
